# Game Sim + Presentation API (llms.txt)

Compact reference for agents working on 3D games with deep simulation. Load this instead of full source when possible. Inspired by VibeGame’s llms.txt pattern.

## Architecture

- Fixed-timestep pure TypeScript simulation.
- Serializable state snapshot is the only contract between sim and renderer.
- Three.js / React Three Fiber lives only in the presentation layer.

## Simulation Surface (fill in per game)

- `tick(dt: number): void` — advance by fixed delta.
- `getState(): GameState` — full serializable snapshot.
- `loadState(json: GameState): void`
- Debug: `window.__hatch` when `?playtest=1`.

## Presentation Surface

- Renderer subscribes to state changes or polls `getState()`.
- No sim logic inside React components or Three.js loops.
- Materials, LOD, lighting, and post-processing are free to be complex.

## Deep Simulation Notes

- Pathfinding, economy, scheduling, and multi-entity rules belong in sim.
- Keep heaps, priority queues, and tick handlers pure.
- Headless tests must cover sim behavior without a canvas.

## Rules Agents Must Follow

- See `studio/rules/sim-isolation.md`
- See `studio/rules/graphics-sim-boundary.md`
- Update this file when the public sim API changes.

Replace the placeholders above with the real signatures once the first game (Hatchfield or other) stabilizes.
